no_adcom_quote.quote: An FDA Advisory Committee Meeting was not held to discuss this application because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for a drug in this class.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the TYMLOS (abaloparatide) NDA208743 application. The Office/Division Director memo, Summary Review, and Cross-Discipline Team Leader review all explicitly state that no advisory committee was held because the application did not raise unexpected efficacy or safety issues for a drug in this class. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to any labeling, PMR/PMC, REMS, or other change to the approval.
